abort.already_configured: This thermostat already belongs to a room.

error.own_entity: Select the real thermostat, not an entity created by this integration.

user.title: Add a room
user.description: A new room starts in observe mode: it calculates and logs, and writes nothing to the thermostat until you select active mode. The water temperature and the outdoor and PV sensors are shared by all rooms and are set on the What the Heat page.

data_description.phase_offset: Set different values for different rooms, so that they do not all open together.
Set different values for different rooms, so that they do not all open together.

set_water_temperature.name: Set water temperature
set_water_temperature.description: Sets the temperature of the water going into the floors, for all rooms. It only tells the controller what the water temperature is, and changes nothing on the heat source.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The temperature set on the mixing valves.

set_sensors.name: Set sensors
set_sensors.description: Sets the outdoor temperature and PV power sensors shared by all rooms. A sensor left out stays as it is, and an empty one is removed.

outdoor_entity.name: Outdoor temperature sensor
outdoor_entity.description: Only logged for now, for learning later.

pv_entity.name: PV power sensor
pv_entity.description: The current power of the PV installation. It tells each room how much sun there is, so that the room can learn what the sun does to it.
